purpose: Experimental hyperparameters for approach 1; they are learned or calibrated from the supplied training split and are not production configuration.

provenance.features: local Lab color distribution, rotation-robust angular-sector/radial spatial pattern statistics, crop-local felt-relative boundary estimate
provenance.training: independent color and cue/solid/stripe logistic heads; identity composed from learned heads
provenance.abstention: minimum of the learned color and pattern probabilities, with a leave-one-scene-out threshold chosen to maximize training-only coverage at zero observed error, plus learned class support and crop-boundary quality
provenance.excluded: No legacy fixed HSV thresholds, hand-coded white ratios, video evaluation labels, or production config values
